Commentary.Commentary: That brings an end to this Bangladesh tour of Sri Lanka. We saw some really competitive games and loved bringing all the action to you. It's time for us to part ways and until we meet again for some other game, it's goodbye and cheers!

Sri Lanka captain, Upul Tharanga is disappointed about today but is proud of the fact that they played competitive cricket through the tournament. Further says his team faltered in the first six overs and things became difficult after that. Credits Shakib Al Hasan for using his variations and bowling smartly and for also using his experience very well. Ends by saying the attitude of his boys has been good but it's important to be consistent if you want to win against such teams.

Mashrafe Mortaza, the victorious skipper says that it's been a fantastic tour and his boys have shown great character in all formats. Also says that he has been to Sri Lanka before but he enjoyed this tour a lot. On his retirement from this format, he replies that finishing with a win is a great thing and he is proud to captain a talented bunch. Also thanks the Bangladesh board and his family for supporting him always.

Man of the Series, Lasith Malinga says the first 3 overs he didn't get any wickets but kept persisting and at the end of the day, got a hat-trick. Informs that he still isn't fully fit but is slowly getting there. Mentions that he can't play much cricket other than T20 right now because of his knee injury so will try and focus on that for the time being.

Man of the Match, Shakib Al Hasan says he thought it was a really good wicket but they were maybe 10 runs short. Opines they started off with the ball well and that got the momentum on their side. States they do not play T20 cricket as much as a team, so there are always areas to improve on. Mentions that it was a fantastic series and credits his boys for showing a lot of character while playing against Sri Lanka in Sri Lanka. Praises and highlights the importance of Mashrafe Mortaza for Bangladesh cricket, wishes him the best of luck and hopes he can continue to share his experience back home.

The visitors, like with the ball now, were good with the bat earlier with some good contributions from their top order batsmen. It was enough to post a total which proved too much for the Sri Lankans. Right then, the Test series ended 1-1, ODI series ended 1-1 and now the T20I series also ended on level terms. A successful tour for the Bangla Tigers. Sri Lanka, on the other hand, are left with a lot of soul searching to do as they cannot keep on giving the excuse of going through the transition phase.

A big win for Bangladesh and they've leveled the series 1-1. After posting a good total on the board, their bowlers came out flying and ran right through the Sri Lankan batting line-up with Shakib Al Hasan and Mustafizur Rahman leading the charge, with 3 and 4 wickets respectively. There was some resistance in the middle from Thisara Perera and Chamara Kapugedera, and the latter went on to score his maiden fifty in this format, but other than that, everybody else fell rather easily.

OUT! Bangladesh win by 45 runs to break their unfortunate 8-match losing streak! Fuller and on middle, Sanjaya gets deep inside the crease and tries to pump it over long off but fails to time his shot. It's aerial and Mahmudullah makes no mistake in the deep. The Bangladesh players are looking ecstatic and their supporters in the crowd are waving the flag. Mortaza is leading them off the park and is congratulated by the players from both sides. Lovely scenes.
Fullish and outside off, once again Vikum throws his bat at it, fails to connect cleanly and sends it over covers for a couple of runs.
FOUR! Not in control but a boundary nonetheless. Full in length around off, Sanjaya heaves it over mid off and it goes over the fielder for a boundary.
Kulasekara has driven it through mid off. One run added to the total.
Great delivery, full and around leg, Nuwan once again swings and misses, and it goes through his legs, missing the leg stump by a whisker. Good take by Rahim.
Full and sliding down the leg side, Kulasekara tries to heave but misses. He is hit on the pads, they appeal but it's missing leg.
Mohammad Saifuddin is back into the attack.
Vikum Sanjaya is the last man in for the Lankans.

OUT! Fourth wicket for Rahman! You miss buddy and I hit! Malinga was just blindly swinging his blade and all Rahman needed to do was put it in the line of the stumps. Lasith misses and it shatters the stumps. End is nigh for Sri Lanka.
Once again Malinga swings and misses. Struggling to pick Rahman.
Length and outside off, Malinga winds up for a big shot over covers but fails to connect.
Driven towards the mid on region. They pick up a single.
Lasith Malinga is the new batsman in.

OUT! No is the answer! Kapugedera holes out. Rahman once again serves a clever slower delivery, 119 kph, full and around off, Chamara is early into his shot and lofts it in the air over mid on. Debutant Mehedi Hasan comes forward a bit from the deep and takes the catch nicely with a tumble. Sri Lanka's last hope departs.
Maiden T20I fifty for Chamara Kapugedera!

FOUR! Lucky boundary! Fuller in length and on middle, Kapugedera gets down on one knee for the slog sweep but it takes a big top edge and sails over the keeper for a boundary. Handy knock by him but the job is not done yet. Can he win it for his side?
Mustafizur Rahman back on to bowl.
Dot ball to end his T20I career! On a length and outside off, Kulasekara defends it back to Mortaza. 4-0-30-1, his last spell in this format. Well done, skipper!
Nuwan Kulasekara to bat next.

OUT! Bowled! Mortaza finally gets one right and has a wicket. He angles in a full ball on middle, Prasanna gives it a mighty swing of his bat but fails to connect. It sneaks through him and destroys the stumps. The umpire quickly checks for the front foot no ball but Mashrafe is fine with his landing. 58 needed off 25 balls!
Full and outside off, hit straight back past the bowler towards long off for two.
Too full in length on off, driven through the cover region for a single.
FOUR! Cracking shot! Back of a length ball on off, Kapugedera holds his ground and packs a punch over covers for a boundary.
On a length and outside off, Seekkuge stays back and punches it through covers for one.
Played to mid-wicket region by the batsman. One run added to the total. Shakib is done for this game, 4-0-25-3!

Flatter arm ball on leg, Kapugedera fails to sweep and it goes off his pads to the left side of the keeper. They cross and Rahim runs to the ball. He turns and has a shy at the striker's end but misses. Direct hit would have been close.
Driven through mid on by the batsman. One run added to the total.
It's been driven superbly through the covers. They pick up a single.
Just short! A full toss on off and it's hit back aerially towards the bowler. Shakib goes down low to take the return catch but it reaches him on one bounce.
Gets forward and gently pushes it towards covers for a single.
Short and wide outside off, slashed through point for a brace.
The batsman guides it to third man. One run added to the total.

NOT OUT! Full in length and around off, Kapugedera gets down on one knee and sweeps it behind square leg. They complete the first run, Kapugedera comes running in for the second but Seekkuge Prasanna has his back to him. The throw comes to Rahim, who collects and has an immediate shy at the non-striker's end. It's heading towards the stumps by Mashrafe decides to collect it ahead of the sticks. He fails to do so and breaks the stumps with his hands. The umpire checks upstairs and the replays show that Kapugedera has survived. Mortaza failed to collect the ball and had he not done anything, it would have been a direct hit which would mean curtains for Chamara!
A run out decision is referred by the umpire. Kapugedera is the man in question here.
Back of a length ball on off, it's punched from the crease to sweeper cover for one.
Shortish ball around off and it's pulled in front of square leg. The fielder in the deep makes a brilliant diving stop and saves two runs for his side.
Play and a miss! Slower full ball outside off, straightening a bit, Prasanna pushes at it and misses.
Mashrafe Mortaza into the attack again.
Flighted ball on middle, drifting in, Prasanna flicks it through mid-wicket for one. End of a successful over and Shakib has brought Bangladesh back on top!
Seekkuge Prasanna is the next man in for Sri Lanka.

OUT! Perera is stumped! Smart bowling by Shakib. He senses the charge from the batsman and bowls it wide outside off, Perera swings and misses. Rahim is quick to dislodge the bails, appeals and the umpire goes upstairs. Thisara is already walking and the replays show that he is short of the crease. Big blow to Sri Lanka. 79 needed off 43 balls!
A stumping appeal against Thisara Perera is referred upstairs by the umpire.
Quicker one outside off, tapped in front of short third man for one.
Yorker around off, Perera digs it out through mid on for a run.
Full floated ball on off, forced down to long off for one.
Flatter and shorter on off, an arm ball, Perera punches it through covers for a single.
There is a partnership going on strongly at the moment and Mashrafe Mortaza needs a wicket. So, Shakib Al Hasan returns to the bowling attack.
A widish yorker outside off, Perera squeezes it out through cover-point and takes a run. 13 off the over!
FOUR! Shot! Slower full ball around leg, Perera picks it early, delays his shot a bit and heaves it over mid-wicket for a boundary. 50-run stand comes up!
A low full toss on the pads, Kapugedera swings it over mid-wicket and takes a run.
Fullish and wide outside off again, Chamara slaps it this time to the right side of the sweeper cover fielder and fetches a couple of runs.
FOUR! Sliced away! Fullish and around off, Chamara tries to go inside-out over covers but gets it away off the outer half of the bat. It flies over point and speeds away to the fence.
Length delivery around middle and leg, heaved to deep mid-wicket for a run.
High full toss around the hips and it's tucked behind square leg for a single.
A low full toss outside off, once again Chamara pierces the gap on the off side and gets a single.
Too full and on off, it's driven through covers for a couple of runs.
FOUR! Cleverly done! Rahman angles across a fullish ball on off, Chamara opens the face of the bat and cleverly guides it past short third man for a boundary.
Third man comes in and square leg drops back.
Angles across a slower length delivery outside off, Kapugedera fails to pick the variation, is early into the shot and misses.
Full toss on off, pumped down to long on for a single.
Mustafizur Rahman is into the attack again.
Low full toss on the stumps, hit hard by the left-hander towards mid on. One run taken and that will be the end of the over.

Great, great stop from Mushfiqur Rahim. Saved a certain boundary. Back-of-the-hand slower delivery from Saifuddin, Kapugedera is early into the shot and cuts it behind in front of Rahim. The keeper dives to his right and stretches his left hand out after falling to the ground to stop the ball. Lovely stuff. Only a single taken.
Full ball on middle and leg, Thisara Perera lofts it towards long off for a single.
Outside off, a bit ahead of a length, driven through covers for one run.
Play and a miss! Full outside off, Chamara with a big drive to whack it through the covers but it misses.

Length delivery in the channel outside off, Kapugedera cuts it towards backward point. Sabbir Rahman dives to his right, collects the ball and has a shy at the bowler's end seeing Thisara go for the run. He runs back and the direct hit misses. Close call, would have been touch and go for Thisara had that hit.
Mohammad Saifuddin is brought into the bowling attack.
From around the wicket, it's flighted on a fuller length, Perera pushes it back down the track for no run.
Full ball attacking the stumps, drilled to the long on fielder for a single.
SIX! Bang and that's gone! Tosses it on a driving length, Kapugedera comes down the track and bobs it back down the ground. Clears the long on fence and gets a biggie to his name.
Floats it up around off, Thisara pushes it in front of covers and hares to the other end to complete the run.
A bit shorter on the hips, glanced to short fine leg for a quick one.
Turning in on off, worked off the inner half on the leg side.
Mahmudullah to roll his arm again.
Fuller around off, pushed away off the front foot to end the over.

Thisara Perera flicks it through mid-wicket and runs hard. Comes back quickly for the second and there is a direct hit at the keeper's end. Fortunately for the southpaw, he's back in just in the nick of time.
Darted and coming in on middle and leg, flicked through mid-wicket by Kapugedera for a single.
Another push from Thisara Perera but this will fetch him a run. He eases it to long off comfortably.
Fuller delivery around off, pushed to the right of the bowler for nothing.
From around the wicket, he fires it across on a flatter trajectory, Chamara dabs it behind square on the off side for a quick run.
Mehedi Hasan will bowl again.
FOUR! On a length, around off, Thisara Perera stands firm and smashes it through extra cover. Good technique, good timing on that as the ball rockets to the boundary line.
That's kicked and bounced! Mortaza pounds it on a back of a length, extracts some extra bounce and makes it difficult for Kapugedera to defend it down on the off side. A single is taken.
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Pretty tight line from Mortaza, cramps Thisara for room and the left-hander can only mistime his slapped shot in front of short extra cover.
Length delivery around off, played off the outer half behind backward point for one.
Length delivery aiming the top of off stump, pushed off the back foot to covers by Kapugedera.
Mashrafe Mortaza is back on.

FOUR! Poor from Soumya Sarkar. A full ball is drilled to him at cover-point, he just lets it right through. Very poor. The ball goes behind away across the rope. Sri Lanka are 47/5 at the end of the Powerplay.
Once again Mustafizur angles one in to Thisara Perera, the southpaw just blocks it out this time.
Full ball angling in on middle and leg, flicked through the mid-wicket region. Mehedi Hasan out in the deep puts in a good dive to stop it and keeps the batsmen to just two.
Wide! Banged in short but it's too short, wide called by the umpire.
No is the answer! How unfortunate for the young lad. He angles in a back of a length delivery from around off, Thisara Perera stays behind the line and blocks.
Thisara Perera walks in to face the hat-trick ball. We have already seen one today in this game by Lasith Malinga. Can Mustafizur?

OUT! TWO IN TWO FOR MUSTAFIZUR! What's going on here? Sri Lanka are having a major collapse. Another golden duck and Mustafizur is now on a hat-trick. Almost a replica of the last delivery, full outside off, driven on the up to Soumya Sarkar at cover-point who catches it comfortably. Seems to have hurt himself in the process but seems fine.
Milinda Siriwardana is the new batsman.

OUT! GOLDEN DUCK FOR ASELA GUNARATNE! Mustafizur Rahman, you little beauty.... Gets a wicket on the first ball of his spell. He hurls across a fuller length ball, Gunaratne drives it hard on the up. Lobs it straight into the hands of Mosaddek Hossain at cover who fumbles and then takes the catch in the second attempt. It popped out from the region near the Adam's Apple and would have hurt Mosaddek. Anyway, a catch taken safely.
Mustafizur Rahman is into the attack.
Stifled shout for an lbw but it's turned down. Was always going down leg. Angling in and it raps Kapugedera on the pads. Stern no from the umpire.
Asela Gunaratne walks in next.

OUT! THE LANKAN SKIPPER DEPARTS! A bit shorter again, Tharanga goes for another pull and ends up top edging this back down the ground. Mehedi Hasan comes running in to his right from mid on and holds on to it safely. A poor shot from Tharanga, was struggling to score anyway and now has finally departed.
FOUR! BANG! Too short and it's been given the treatment. Upul Tharanga hangs back and pulls it nicely over wide mid on to send it across the rope for a boundary.
Up and over! Good shot. Tharanga goes across, kneels down and drops it over backward square leg. Fortunately for him, it falls safely and so, two runs are taken.
Flatter on leg, Upul tries to nudge but is struck on the front pad.
Shorter and flatter in trajectory on the stumps, Tharanga is in no control of this shot as he mistimes the pull aerially just in front of mid on.
Mahmudullah to roll his arm now.
The batsman failed to make contact and was hit low on the pads. They pick up a single. The umpire signals leg bye.

DROPPED! Oh, dear... It's Mashrafe Mortaza who's made a mess of it. And it was the simplest of catches, really. He isn't having the best of farewells, is he? First a golden duck and now a drop. Full around off, Tharanga makes room and chips it straight to Mortaza who moves to his right and spills it right out of his hands.
Darted on middle and leg, drilled down to long on for a run.

FOUR! Bit streaky but he got enough on that. Some decent flight on that, turning in ever so slightly on off, Kapugedera lofts it over mid off. Just about clears the mid off fielder and it beats the chasing fielder to the boundary.
Flatter ball on off, Upul with a drive down to long off for a single.
FOUR! Great shot. Short, flat and around off, Tharanga hangs back and chops it perfectly in the gap. Gets it right between point and backward point to send it all the way.
Debutant Mehedi Hasan is introduced into the attack.
Easily done. This loopy and full ball is eased through the cover region for a couple of good runs. Lovely timing on that, did not hit it hard at all.
Brings the wrists into play and works it away on the leg side for one run.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Wide! Angling down leg, Tharanga attempts to flick but misses. Wide called.
Chamara Kapugedera is the new batsman.

OUT! SHAKIB STRIKES AGAIN! His second wicket in as many overs. He floats it up on off, Munaweera plays the slog sweep and gets a top edge on it. Lobs towards Mahmudullah at mid-wicket who runs a few paces behind to take an easy catch. Great start for Shakib and Bangladesh, the veteran is using his experience well in such a situation.
Shorter in length, coming in on leg, catches Dilshan on the pads as he tries to play.
FOUR! From around the wicket, Shakib tosses it up on middle and off, Munaweera makes room, opens his body up and drives it elegantly through the covers to start the over off with a boundary.
Outside off on a back of a length, punched away on the off side for nothing.
Short ball from Mortaza, from around the wicket, Upul goes for the big pull but connects with only thin air.
Short and wide outside off, cut away straight to the point fielder. He'll feel disappointed, it was there to be hit and it's hit area.

Short and into the body, Tharanga pulls it behind square on the leg side. Mehedi Hasan out in the deep does well to run to his left and dive to stop it just inside the rope. Save two vital runs for his side.
FOUR! Shot! Short and on off, a bit cramped for room but Tharanga gets this away beautifully. Stands tall and pulls it firmly through the mid-wicket region for a boundary.
Angles across a length delivery, outside off, Tharanga cuts it behind backward point. The third man fielder cuts it off and keeps the batsmen down to two.
Mashrafe Mortaza to bowl from the other end.
Floated full and it's driven to long on for one.
Dropped short on middle and off, Tharanga rocks back and pulls it through towards deep mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot.
Full and flighted on middle and off, flicked to the mid-wicket fielder.
Upul Tharanga walks in at No.3.

OUT! SHAKIB STRIKES! Just the start Bangladesh needed. Beautiful bowling, that's a big wicket. The man who wreaked havoc in the last game has been dismissed on the second ball of the innings. Turning in from around off on a bit of a shorter length, Kusal Perera backs away to cut but ends up chopping it back onto the stumps. The bails are off, the Tigers celebrate and the southpaw will have to walk back.

FOUR! A boundary to start things off with. Shakib bowls it slower through the air and loops it up on middle and leg, Kusal Perera sweeps this away off the inside half past the short fine leg fielder for a boundary.
We are back for the chase. It will be Kusal Perera and Dilshan Munaweera to open the innings with Shakib Al Hasan to start off with the ball. Spin to get things underway for Bangladesh. Let's go...
